_doc: Long guns (ADR-0057). The bolt-action hunting rifle: five rounds loaded one at a time (R: the bolt opens, reload_time per round, the bolt closes; firing stops a reload), each shot followed by a bolt cycle (bolt_time) before the next. Right mouse raises it to the scope (equip.aim: zoom factor of the view, spread / sway / move multipliers while fully aimed, seconds to raise; scope: a scope picture once up). Found, not made: gun safes, lookout stores, the Waystation's trusted shelf.

defs.name: Hunting Rifle
defs.description: A walnut-stocked .308 bolt gun under a 3-9x scope. Someone's deer rifle. It'll drop anything in the valley at two hundred metres, and every Hollowed for a mile hears it.

defs.name: .308 Rounds
defs.description: Long brass, soft points. Hunting ammunition: there were never many in the valley and there won't be more.
